traits.name: Damage Resistances
traits.description: Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the barbed devil deals 5 (1d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it. (Descriptive only: no start-of-turn damage to a grappler. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision. (Descriptive only: no engine flag.)

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The devil makes three melee attacks: one with its tail and two with its claws. Alternatively, it can use Hurl Flame twice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame

attack_bonus.reason: SRD 5.1 Barbed Devil Hurl Flame prints +5 (Cha +2 + PB 3). natural.ability is str or dex only; Str 16 and Dex 17 each derive +6. ability none: a Str or Dex reduction does not recompute it.

actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire. (The flammable-object clause is descriptive only, as fire elemental Ignite. The attack is the 3d6 fire. Range is 150/150: one range, no long-range band. The printed bonus is Cha +2 + PB 3. natural.ability is str or dex only, so attack_bonus carries +5 and ability is none. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)
